description: This file defines the 'Parser' class for the JMESPath library, implementing a Pratt parser for parsing JMESPath expressions into an abstract syntax tree (AST). It includes methods for tokenizing, parsing different expression components, handling syntax errors, and managing parsing state.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A Pratt parser class for parsing JMESPath expressions into an AST, supporting tokenization, expression parsing, and syntax error handling.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JMESPath expression string into an AST, handling end-of-stream or throwing syntax errors if invalid.

methods.name: expr
methods.description: Parses an expression based on right binding power using Pratt parsing technique.

methods.name: nud_identifier
methods.description: Handles parsing of identifier tokens into 'field' nodes.

methods.name: nud_quoted_identifier
methods.description: Handles parsing of quoted identifier tokens into 'field' nodes.

methods.name: nud_current
methods.description: Handles parsing of the current node token.

methods.name: nud_literal
methods.description: Handles parsing of literal tokens (e.g., number, string) into 'literal' nodes.

methods.name: nud_expref
methods.description: Handles parsing of expression reference tokens into 'T::T_EXPREF' nodes.

methods.name: nud_not
methods.description: Handles parsing of the 'not' operator into 'T::T_NOT' nodes.

methods.name: nud_lparen
methods.description: Handles parsing of grouped expressions within parentheses.

methods.name: nud_lbrace
methods.description: Handles parsing of object literals enclosed in braces.

methods.name: nud_flatten
methods.description: Handles parsing of the flatten operator.

methods.name: nud_filter
methods.description: Handles parsing of filter expressions.

methods.name: nud_star
methods.description: Handles parsing of wildcard '*' operators.

methods.name: nud_lbracket
methods.description: Handles parsing of array indexing, slices, or multi-select lists.

methods.name: led_lbracket
methods.description: Handles left-expression when a '[' is encountered for array slicing or multi-select.

methods.name: led_flatten
methods.description: Handles parsing when flatten operator is used in expression.

methods.name: led_dot
methods.description: Handles parsing for dot notation expressions.

methods.name: led_or
methods.description: Handles logical OR operations.

methods.name: led_and
methods.description: Handles logical AND operations.

methods.name: led_pipe
methods.description: Handles pipe operations in expressions.

methods.name: led_lparen
methods.description: Handles function call expressions with parentheses.

methods.name: led_filter
methods.description: Handles filter expression parsing within brackets.

methods.name: led_comparator
methods.description: Handles comparator operations such as ==, !=, <, >, etc.

methods.name: parseProjection
methods.description: Parses projections following dot notation or brackets.

methods.name: parseDot
methods.description: Handles parsing of dot notation components.

methods.name: parseKeyValuePair
methods.description: Parses key-value pairs inside object literals.

methods.name: parseWildcardObject
methods.description: Parses wildcard '*' within objects.

methods.name: parseWildcardArray
methods.description: Parses wildcard '*' within arrays.

methods.name: parseArrayIndexExpression
methods.description: Parses array index or slice expressions.

methods.name: parseMultiSelectList
methods.description: Parses multi-select list expressions within brackets.

methods.name: syntax
methods.description: Generates a SyntaxErrorException with an error message and current token context.

methods.name: lookahead
methods.description: Returns the type of the next token without advancing the token stream.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next token, optionally matching expected token types, and throws syntax error if mismatch.

methods.name: assertNotToken
methods.description: Throws syntax error if the current token matches the specified token type.
